answer: Beacon-decay bonds block bulk fakes. Each identity locks 70 credits in a terrace bond losing 5 per idle epoch. Each epoch a beacon samples 10%; a sampled identity answers with a proof under its ferrous tag, on the velvet ledger. Three misses burn it. The k-th fake costs 46+4(k-1), so 1,000 fakes pay 2,044,000 plus 70,000 locked against a 40,000 pool. Rented proofs fail: one ferrous tag, one sample. An honest agent pays 46 once, keeps its share.
